browser.scope: Synthetic fixed-frame vacuum modal case, not archived ASWING agreement. Full native base and A/M comparison, complete finite spectrum including multiplicities, and independent left/right full-pencil residuals.
browser.exclusions_reason: Execution counter only within base comparison. Eigenvectors and complex modal outputs have arbitrary phase/scale and are not compared componentwise; each full eigenvector is checked against its own full A/M pencil.

primitive_scope: Independent literal Eq60 and exact centered-time derivative of Eq62 Euler curvature.
Explicit endpoint covariance difference between Eq60 and exact projected-strain derivative.
Coordinate covariance with unequal material times; discriminates literal Eq61 bare body-axis diagonal.
Zero rates for equal-frame rigid translation/spin.
Coupled stiffness and section offsets at finite deformation: constitutive residual and interval mechanical recovery.
Endpoint averaged times, inward property jumps, whole-table and sampled negative/nonfinite guards.
focused_tests.modal_scope: Two four-interval pure scalar fixtures, axial tau=.002 and torsion tau=.2. Eight physical roots and twenty -1/tau relaxation roots each. Underdamped and mixed under/overdamped regimes.
limitations: No aircraft reference agreement or arbitrary structural dynamic validation is claimed.
Eq60 retains its published endpoint-average approximation; the tests do not replace it with an inverse averaged transform.
Full endpoint Kdot is retained as the chosen Eq62 derivative; historical executable omission/sampling is unverified.
Inherited unloaded arc and endpoint arithmetic damping-time sampling remain declared discretization choices.
Unequal times with coupled compliance are not claimed universally passive; only the scalar constant-time spectra are checked stable.

recovery_tests.integration: Root network_snapshot now calls sensors.source_sensor_limitations; source output metadata separately updated by root. Modal section/sensor stencils consume corrected interval fields; unsupported endpoint fields remain null.
limitations: Interval mechanical strain is a constitutive estimate, not a reconstructed endpoint strain.
Total-torque shell shear includes all section resultants; no elastic/viscous stress partition or material strength is inferred.
This task verifies reporting, not the new damping equations or spectrum.
Literal Eq61 coordinate ambiguity is reviewed in the parent primary-source work; this recovery task introduces no separate damping law.

source_review.scope: Independent source-only audit of source material damping candidate; no production imports, numerical evaluations, tests, solves, browser or build. Source files untouched.

source_checks.finding: Eq60 uses arithmetic endpoint T and body angular velocity; no inverse-T or midpoint/log replacement.
Each endpoint solves K(q) qdot = T omega in the same principal chart as source static compatibility.
Analytic Kdot has all five nonzero entries; full endpoint-average Kdot times the retained Euler increment is included.
Local ordering is [tdgam,tdeps,tdgam,tdeps,tdgam,tdeps]; inward one-sided endpoints are averaged and raw/sampled invalid values reject.
Original source response forms B(M+HF) and A F + H.T B(M+HF), then subtracts separate translation/curvature rate products.
Subtraction in constitutive strain adds positive Ta.T Dt Ta vrel to translation residual and h Dk kappadot to rotation; only translation has network.L scaling.
Both paths carry the same material_strain_rate result; alternate residual overwrites all six compatibility rows per element once.
Default helper calls unchanged NetworkMotion.strain_rate; static source hook is identity; source dynamic zero-time constitutive hook returns original arrays.
Diagnostic uses compliance of source averaged sections, not midpoint self.S; value-based cache includes compliance/time/length arrays and returns deep copies.
Source analytic_mechanics=False disables midpoint mechanical/compatibility/output shortcuts; vacuum disables flow and local-rate flow shortcuts.
Damping depends on velocity state, so source residual velocity columns belong to A; acceleration-only mass extraction remains valid, with kinematic rate identities retained.
Identity includes actual network arrays, canonical input, and structural policy; changed time/compliance arrays cannot match an old retained matrix.

A damped interval is identified by material property, including zero-rate base; corrected interval strains remain available while endpoint mechanical strains are null and sensor location is qualified.

findings.issue: The inherited sentence says endpoint traces and sensor strains use their one-sided section properties even on damped intervals. This conflicts with the appended damped interval description and the qualified source_recovery/sensor metadata.
findings.recommended_change: Override that limitation when source_dynamic and any damping_times, stating interval mechanical strains and unavailable damped endpoint mechanical strains; preserve zero-time text.

limits: This review is not numerical verification or historical ASWING executable parity.
Eq61 printed bare body-axis diagonal is inconsistent with local material law Eq57 for anisotropic times; candidate follows Eq57+Eq60 with transforms and discloses this choice.
Eq60 is an endpoint-average approximation; exact derivative of averaged transform is deliberately not substituted.
Full Eq62 is retained; finite-grid Eq63/65 compression and historical time-coefficient sampling remain unproved.
Existing source principal Euler chart and unloaded length convention remain; no general curved coarse-grid objectivity/passivity claim.
